Rarely available and on the rental market for the first time in 40 years - a fully remodeled top-floor Victorian apartment in the heart of the Mission District. Approximately 1,400 sq ft, blending original 1910 character with a complete 2026 renovation.
THE HOME
- 3 spacious bedrooms
- Full bath plus a separate toilet room
- Two grand formal rooms (living and dining), each with an original Victorian fireplace, bay windows, and built-in china cabinets
- Restored original oak and parquet floors, high ceilings, wainscoting and crown molding
- Remodeled kitchen: quartz-style counters and backsplash, stainless refrigerator, gas range, generous cabinetry
- Updated bath: marble-style tile, glass-enclosed shower, modern black fixtures
- In-unit laundry, central heat and A/C, smart doorbell
- Shared greenhouse bonus space
- Sweeping downtown San Francisco skyline views from the top floor
TERMS

Available: immediately
Included in rent: water and trash

Located steps from the restaurants and shops along 22nd Street, with convenient access to transit.

DESCRIPTION:
Remodeled compact and efficiently designed approximately 800 sq. ft. apartment with three similarly sized bedrooms and two full bathrooms. The living/common area is modest in size, while the layout provides three separate bedrooms, making excellent use of the available space.
•Remodeled apartment in a three-unit building
•Prime Inner Richmond location on a desirable block facing Park Presidio greenbelt
•Apartment located at the quiet rear of the building
•Hardwood-style flooring throughout
•Remodeled kitchen with granite countertops
•Stainless-steel appliances and gas range
•Two remodeled tiled bathrooms
•Three similarly sized bedrooms
•In-unit washer and dryer
•Recessed lighting
•Newer interior paint
•Large, sunny shared yard
LOCATION:
The apartment is in Inner Richmond, half a block to Golden Gate Park, with convenient access restaurants, cafés, shopping, neighborhood services, public transportation, and easy access to USF. The building itself has an attractive Edwardian façade and is situated on a pleasant residential block. Good street parking, excellent access to public transportation, and a short drive to 280 or 101 freeways for a commute to the valley. The financial district is twenty minutes away, and many private and tech bus routes are nearby. Walk Score: 88 - Transit Score: 76 – Bike Score: 96
LEASE TERMS:
Available for move-in October 1st. We prefer a one-year lease but may consider other terms. To schedule a private tour, please email us through this posting.

A rare Bernal Heights rental with space, privacy, views, outdoor living, and parking, all in one home.
This bright ~1,800 sq ft, 3-bedroom home offers the kind of space that's increasingly hard to find in San Francisco: generous living areas, a private full-floor upper bedroom, beautiful natural light, a private deck, in-unit laundry, and carport parking with EV charger.
THE SPACE
The heart of the home is a large, light-filled living room framed by classic bay windows with beautiful views. Hardwood floors and abundant natural light give the space a warm, open feel, with plenty of room for both everyday living and entertaining.
The home's layout separates living and sleeping spaces, making it especially well suited for a couple or family that wants room to spread out—or anyone looking for a true work-from-home setup without sacrificing a bedroom.
Two bedrooms are located on the main bedroom level.
Then there's the top floor.
The entire upper level is dedicated to the third bedroom, creating a private retreat with skylights, abundant natural light, and its own sink and toilet.
Use it as an oversized primary bedroom, private guest space, bedroom + office, or creative studio.
PRIVATE OUTDOOR SPACE
Step outside onto your private deck for morning coffee, outdoor dinners, or a quiet place to unwind.
It's an extension of the living space and one of the home's standout features.
THE EVERYDAY LUXURIES
✓ ~1,800 sq ft
✓ 3 bedrooms
✓ 2 bathrooms
✓ Private full-floor upper bedroom
✓ Bay windows + views
✓ Private deck
✓ Off-street parking
✓ Washer + dryer in unit

✓ Pets welcome

BERNAL HEIGHTS
Enjoy the neighborhood feel Bernal is known for, while staying incredibly close to the rest of San Francisco.
Restaurants, coffee shops, neighborhood favorites, parks and everyday essentials are close by, with easy access to Cortland Avenue, Mission Street, Noe Valley, Glen Park, the Mission and major commuter routes.
You get the quieter, residential character of Bernal without feeling removed from the city.

Family home available for sublet in sunny Bernal Heights while we are travelling. We are seeking subletters who will enjoy our home and take care of it. Perfect for families, individuals, and couples of all ages. Our house is filled with character, with expansive views of downtown and the city, and would be most enjoyed by artistic individuals who appreciate creative architecture. The main floor includes a beautiful kitchen and living room, multiple bedrooms, a bathroom, and office space. The downstairs levels include additional sleeping areas, bathrooms, and a spacious family room. We are located on a flat street with a wide sidewalk, accessible on foot to all amenities.
